description: Organization GitHub Copilot telemetry from Application Insights. Requires an Azure Monitor datasource and a Log Analytics workspace resource selected in the 'workspace' variable. Minimum Grafana 10.0. Every query names the table and customDimensions fields it reads; verify them against your own workspace, because attribute names follow the extension build rather than this file.
title: GitHub Copilot - Organization Telemetry (Azure)

list.name: workspace
list.label: Log Analytics workspace
list.description: Full resource ID of the Log Analytics workspace backing Application Insights.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where isnotempty(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'])
| extend model = tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.request.model'])
| extend input_tokens = tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'])
| extend output_tokens = tolong(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'])
| summarize InputTokens = sum(input_tokens), OutputTokens = sum(output_tokens) by bin(timestamp, 15m), model
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Reporting hosts
panels.description: Distinct cloud_RoleInstance values. A proxy for how many workstations are exporting, not a licensed-seat count.

panels.title: Total spans (range)
panels.description: Ingestion volume proxy. This number drives the Log Analytics bill.

panels.title: LLM call duration p50 and p95 by model
panels.description: Reads dependencies.duration in milliseconds, grouped by customDimensions['gen_ai.request.model'].

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where isnotempty(customDimensions['gen_ai.request.model'])
| extend model = tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.request.model'])
| summarize p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95) by bin(timestamp, 15m), model
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Failed operations
panels.description: Reads dependencies.success. A rising line here usually means the collector or the model endpoint, not the editor.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| summarize Failures = countif(success == false), Total = count() by bin(timestamp, 15m)
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Top tools (range)
panels.description: Reads dependencies.customDimensions['gen_ai.tool.name']. MCP tools appear under their mcp_ prefixed names.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where isnotempty(customDimensions['gen_ai.tool.name'])
| extend tool = tostring(customDimensions['gen_ai.tool.name'])
| summarize Calls = count() by tool
| top 15 by Calls desc

panels.title: Custom agent activity
panels.description: Reads dependencies.customDimensions['copilot_chat.mode_name'], which carries the user-selected custom agent. Metrics do not carry this dimension; it exists only on spans.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where isnotempty(customDimensions['copilot_chat.mode_name'])
| extend agent = tostring(customDimensions['copilot_chat.mode_name'])
| extend agent_type = tostring(customDimensions['github.copilot.agent.type'])
| summarize Invocations = count(), Hosts = dcount(cloud_RoleInstance), MedianDurationMs = percentile(duration, 50) by agent, agent_type
| order by Invocations desc

panels.title: Activity by team
panels.description: Reads the team.id resource attribute set in Copilot managed settings. Empty until resourceAttributes carries it.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| extend team = tostring(customDimensions['team.id'])
| where isnotempty(team)
| summarize Operations = count() by bin(timestamp, 1h), team
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Content attributes present
panels.description: Prompt and response text has been observed on spans even with captureContent disabled. A non-zero count here means content is reaching billable storage and the collector's strip-content processor is not applied.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| summarize
    UserRequest = countif(isnotempty(customDimensions['copilot_chat.user_request'])),
    InputMessages = countif(isnotempty(customDimensions['gen_ai.input.messages'])),
    OutputMessages = countif(isnotempty(customDimensions['gen_ai.output.messages'])),
    ToolArguments = countif(isnotempty(customDimensions['gen_ai.tool.call.arguments'])),
    SystemInstructions = countif(isnotempty(customDimensions['gen_ai.system_instructions']))
